field_descriptions.cook_time: The time it takes to actually cook the dish, in [ISO 8601 duration format](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601).
field_descriptions.cooking_method: The method of cooking, such as Frying, Steaming, ...
field_descriptions.identifier: The identifier property represents any kind of identifier for any kind of [[Thing]], such as ISBNs, GTIN codes, UUIDs etc. Schema.org provides dedicated properties for representing many of these, either as textual strings or as URL (URI) links. See [background notes](/docs/datamodel.html#identifierBg) for more details.
field_descriptions.ingredients: A single ingredient used in the recipe, e.g. sugar, flour or garlic.
field_descriptions.nutrition: Nutrition information about the recipe or menu item.
field_descriptions.recipe_category: The category of the recipe—for example, appetizer, entree, etc.
field_descriptions.recipe_cuisine: The cuisine of the recipe (for example, French or Ethiopian).
field_descriptions.recipe_ingredient: An ingredient or ordered list of ingredients and potentially quantities used in the recipe, e.g. 1 cup of sugar, flour or garlic.  The ingredients can be represented as free text or more structured values.
field_descriptions.recipe_instructions: A step in making the recipe, in the form of a single item (document, video, etc.) or an ordered list with HowToStep and/or HowToSection items.
field_descriptions.recipe_yield: The quantity produced by the recipe (for example, number of people served, number of servings, etc).
field_descriptions.suitable_for_diet: Indicates a dietary restriction or guideline for which this recipe or menu item is suitable, e.g. diabetic, halal etc.
